review_candidates.description: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Avionics Engineer – A330 to join our Engineering team. The role will support both Continuing Airworthiness Management Organization (CAMO) activities and active Line/Base Maintenance operations, ensuring the technical integrity, reliability, and continued airworthiness of the Airbus A330 fleet’s avionics, electrical, and cabin electronic systems. The successful candidate will provide high-level technical support for maintenance operations, including O, I and D Level maintenance where applicable, and will act as a technical focal point for complex avionics-related issues. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace, Aeronautical, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline. A330 type rating is mandatory Minimum Experience Minimum 8+ years of experience in an airline, MRO, Technical Services, CAMO, Base Maintenance or Line Maintenance Engineering environment. Strong technical knowledge of Airbus A330 avionics and electrical systems, including Fly-By-Wire, Autoflight, Navigation, Communication, EFIS, ADIRS and Central Maintenance Systems. Proven experience using Airbus technical documentation, including AMM, IPC, TSM, ASM, ESPM and SRM. Experience in defect investigation, reliability monitoring, troubleshooting and technical reporting. Previous A330 MRTT experience will be considered a strong advantage. Knowledge of military aircraft maintenance operations and special mission systems is preferred. Key Responsibilities Review and assess Airworthiness Directives, Service Bulletins and other regulatory or manufacturer requirements related to A330 avionics systems. Prepare and issue Engineering Orders and technical instructions in line with applicable airworthiness requirements. Analyze fleet technical data, pilot reports, repetitive defects and reliability trends to identify corrective actions and improve fleet performance. Support the review and optimization of the avionics and electrical sections of the Aircraft Maintenance Programme. Evaluate and support the implementation of modifications, STCs, software configuration updates and avionics system upgrades. Provide advanced troubleshooting guidance to Line and Base Maintenance teams for complex or recurring avionics defects. Support AOG recovery by coordinating with Airbus Technical Support, OEMs and internal maintenance teams to expedite technical solutions. Monitor and manage MEL deferred defects, ensuring compliance with rectification intervals and operational requirements. Ensure engineering data, repairs and alterations comply with EASA Part-CAMO, Part-145 or applicable local authority requirements. Maintain accurate technical records and support internal and external airworthiness audits. Liaise with OEMs, including Airbus, Thales, Honeywell and other system suppliers, on technical queries, reliability issues and warranty claims. Act as a technical subject matter expert for avionics maintenance issues, supporting quality, safety and effective repair solutions. Comply with all relevant safety, quality and environmental management policies, procedures and controls. Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with departmental policies, standard operating procedures and applicable regulatory requirements. Required Skills and Competencies Strong knowledge of A330 avionics, electrical and cabin electronic systems. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Ability to manage complex technical issues, engineering projects and modification activities. Ability to respond effectively to shifting priorities, urgent operational requirements and AOG situations. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and MRO / airworthiness management software. Strong teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to work within a multidisciplinary engineering and maintenance environment. High attention to detail, particularly in airworthiness compliance records and technical documentation.
